nights.title: Prateek Kuhad
nights.name: Prateek Kuhad
nights.extract: Prateek Kuhad is an Indian singer-songwriter and musician who makes independent music in Hindi and English. He is best known for his track "Kasoor" and "Co2".

nights.title: Sabrina Claudio
nights.name: Sabrina Claudio
nights.extract: Sabrina Claudio is an American singer and songwriter. In late 2016, Claudio uploaded several songs to SoundCloud, before compiling a select collection as part of her debut extended play, Confidently Lost, which was released independently in March 2017.

nights.title: Beauty School Dropout
nights.name: Beauty School Dropout
nights.extract: Beauty School Dropout is an American rock band formed in Los Angeles, California, in 2020 by lead vocalist Cole "Colie" Hutzler, bassist Brent "Beepus" Burdett, producer/guitarist Bardo Novotny and drummer Colton Flurry.
